image_description: A modern interior staircase featuring a prominent, glossy red handrail system. The handrail is thick and tubular, curving along the incline of white steps. It is supported by thin, vertical black metal balusters. A large grey newel post/wall structure anchors the left side, displaying a sign with text 'NORDEA'. In the background, another flight of stairs with similar railing continues upward.
